templates.name: basic_ini
templates.body:
[common]
server_addr=127.0.0.1
server_port=7000
token=your_token

[ssh]
type=tcp
local_ip=127.0.0.1

remote_port=6000

templates.name: basic_toml
templates.body:
serverAddr = '127.0.0.1'

auth.token = 'your_token'

[[proxies]]
name = 'web'
type = 'tcp'
localIP = '127.0.0.1'
localPort = 8080
remotePort = 18080
